items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That was Herbert Russell. Herbert. [INTERVIEWER] I knew Johnny, I knew Johnny but I never knew Herbert.

ctx.x: Lindsey, he come there behind Buddy. Lindsey, Johnny Lindsey.

Yeah, Johnny Lindsey, he used to play bass you know. Yeah, he played bass with his daddy. Yeah, with his daddy. What does his daddy play? His daddy used to play guitar. Guitar. Yeah, and his brother used to play violin. That was Herbert Russell. Herbert.

I knew Johnny, I knew Johnny but I never knew Herbert. But Herbert was still in Chicago a few years ago and I couldn't find him. Yeah. I tried to find him in 1958, six years ago. Yeah. And he was still there. He owned him. He might be dead now but he was there. No. I told you who saw him, you remember some singers, Mack and Mack? Mack and Mack, yeah. They were still up there and they said they saw him at a grocery store every once in a while but when they tried to find him they didn't see him. I was only there a…
